content: Pauli ijhambucha bhando bhu ku Loma
Nipala mumanye nnombo gwito Foibe jwabhii ntumiche mu likunde lya bhando libhanyeketii Kilichitu lya ku Kenikuleya.
Mupokele kwa liina lya Bhambo, ngita chimapoke bhando bha Chapanga. Mtangatile chochoha chela channyopa kuhumii kwino, nhwalo jwenio abhatangatii bhando twe na helahela andangatile na nenga.
Unyambuchile Pilisila na Akula, akahenga mahengo ajhango mu lihengo lya Kilichitu Yecho.
Bhene bhakibha mukuhandaanda jha kuwegha ne ng'ombokoke. Bhitope kuchengulilwa, chi kwa nenga kanjika, ata kwa likunde lya bhando bhibhanyeketii Kilichitu bha ilambo yoha bhinchengula.
Unyambuchila bhando bhibhanyeketii Kilichitu bhibhakongana ukajhabhe. Helahela unyambuchila nkoche gwango Epeneto jwatumbwila kunyeketela Kilichitu jwa kubomane jha ku Asiya.
Unyambuchila Maliya, jwakangamila kuhenga lihengo hake kwa nhwalo gwino.
Unyambuchila Anduloniko na Yuniya, Akayahude ajhango bhibhakatabhitwe mukipungo pamonga na nenga. Bhene bhakamanyikine hake pakate jha akatenga, kabhele bheniya bhakalongolile kunyeketela Kilichitu.
Unyambuchila Amupuliato, nkoche gwango jhunimpahii mukulombana na Bhambo.
Unyambuchila Alubano, nhenga lihengo nnyango jwa Kilichitu, na nkoche gwango jhunimpahii Sitaku.
Unyambuchila Apele, jwajhighanikilwe na kulangii jwenio kubhehe jwambone kwa Kilichitu. Helahela unyambuchila bhando bhoha bhibhabhii ukajha mwa Alisitubulo.
Unyambuchile nnongo gwango Helodiana na likunde lya bhando bhibhannyeketii Kilichitu bhibhabhii ukajha mwa Nalukisi.
Unyambuchila Tulepeniya na Tulupona, akakeghe bhubhanhengila Bhambo. Helahela unyambuchila na nnombo gwango Pelise nkeghe jhonge jwanhengela hake Bhambo.
Unyambuchila Lupo, mundo jwangajhoghopa mulihengo lya Bhambo, pamo na majhe mundo, helahela jwakibha ngita majhe gwango.
Unyambulichila Asunikulito na Fulegone na Helime na Patuloba na Heluba na bhando bhoha bhibhabhii pamonga na bhene.
Unyambuchila Filologo na Yuliya na Neleya na nnombo mundo, na Olimpa pamonga na bhando bhoha bha Chapanga bhibhabhii pamonga na bheniya.
Nnyambuchana mabhene kwa mabhene kwa nginyililo jha upalo. Bhando bhoha bhibhanyeketii Kilichitu, unyambuchila.
Malobhe gha kujhomolela
Makalongo bhango, nimpembelekeya mukilolekeye na bhala bhibhantenda mpechengane na kwatenda bhando bhange bhaleke mabholo ghubhapokii. Mukibhambahe na bhando bheniya,
nhwalo bhando ngita bheniya bhinhenge jhe Kilichitu Bhambo gwito, nambo bhaghahenge matumbo ghabhe bhene. Kwa malobhe ghabhe gha kunoghe na gha kukihutila kumwojho bhakopekeya bhando bhangalemwa.

Nhwalo mangota umanyikana kwa bhando bhoha kwa kunnyokanikii Bhambo, yenio nihangana kwa nhwalo gwino. Nimpalangana mme na malango kwa kuhenga ghambone na mme nkwete jhe ulemo mu kuhenga ghanganandela.
Chapanga jwabhii lihembuko lya uteeke nabhe jhe na kiyoto kukinya Limbembela pahe jha magholo ghino. Umbone gwa jhajhe gwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu ubhaha na mangota.
Timocheyo, nhenga lihengo nnyango, anyambucha. Helahela nnongo gwango Lukiyo na Yasoni na Sosipateli, akajhango bhinyambucha.
Na nenga Telitiyo, jhuninnyandikila Pauli baluwa jhenje, ninyambucha kwa liina lya Bhambo.

Gayo jhunihikilile, pamonga na likunde lya bhando bhoha bhibhanyeketii Kilichitu bhibhakongana kajhake, anyambucha. Elasito jwabhekita kihukilo cha mbijha cha muche ghongo, pamonga na nnongo gwito Kwalito, bhinyambucha.
Umbone gwa jhajhe gwa Bhambo gwito Yecho ubhaha na mangota mabhoha. Amina.
Pauli innomba Chapanga
Bhahe, ngoheno tunnomba Chapanga jwahotola kukangamalicha mu Lilobhe lela lya Mbone linongila Yecho Kilichitu, na mu kiyepela kwa jhiyekulilwe na jhikibha ihitwe kwa yaka twe ipetite.

Nambo ngoheno uchakaka ndi gwenio uyekulilwe kwa ndela jha majhandiko gha akalondole bha Chapanga, na kwa mihilo jha Chapanga jha machiko ghoha ghangapeta kwa bhando bhoha bha nnema bhahoto kuhobholela na kujheketela.
Kwa Chapanga jwabhii kanjika jhuna malango, abhaha na ung'alicho kwa ndela jha Yecho kilichitu machiko ghoha ghangapeta. Amina.
